about: The words RecipeTextSplitter reads Japanese free text with (a Reddit post, #11, or a photo's lines, #198, #208). The keys are explained in en/splitter.json. Japanese has no spaces between words, so only whole-line headers apply ('材料', '【作り方】', '材料（2人分）'): no keywords, misspellings or 'for' headers. The amount comes after the name ('鶏もも肉 2枚', '砂糖 大さじ2'), so amountPatterns say what an amount looks like. No glued units: the words are never spaced.
amountPatterns: (?:大さじ|小さじ|大匙|小匙|カップ)\s*[0-9０-９½]
